data.description: Builds and launches the real aworkit-desktop.exe in isolated live-QA mode against the local Qwen OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Exercises the production DesktopRuntime, provider adapter, frozen workflow authority, approval resume path, base agent loop, and every installed built-in tool. No fixture provider, mock tool dispatcher, or parallel test runtime is used.
